description: After nearly three years of development, the Optimist 145 is here! Well, almost here. We are still in the final throws of development but are at a place where we can commit to a production timeline and offer you the opportunity to get in on the launch edition pre-order. This is no ordinary launch edition. The Optimist 145 comes with every banger part available to make this the ultimate full suspension bike. Featuring a full titanium front triangle mated to a fully CNC machined rear triangle, the Optimist combines the amazing damping properties of titanium with the stiffness of alloy in the rear triangle where torsional rigidity is needed for belt alignment and suspension performance. The front triangle is outrageous. All three lugs (head tube, Pinion Bridge, and Seat Cluster) are 3d printed out of titanium and mated to titanium tubes seamlessly. This work of art is functional as well as beautiful, with built in seat collar and internal bracing for maximum strength and minimum weight. Launch Edition partners include Industry 9, Intend, Chris King, Vittoria, and more.
